_provenance: Phase 3 · 3b classification artifact — clusters the 82 nine-field cards in book-models/catalogue-cards.json into the GEE 4-level ontology (Capabilities / Canonical mechanisms L2 / Compositions / Variants+known-uses L3) plus the L1 explanatory principles, per book/_design/book-editorial-discipline-directive-260802.md §§ Task 3 / SUPPLEMENT / SUPPLEMENT 2 and phase3b-brief-260803.md. READ-ONLY wrt entries: 3b DECIDES the architecture; 3c EXECUTES the rewrite. Hand-authored analysis (not machine-generated); do not treat as a declared→generated model file. catalog.py validate is unaffected (this is a book-models analysis artifact, not a catalogue entry).
_note: The CLAIM: the DocAble case produced 82 concrete governance mechanisms; comparative analysis by the card+cluster rule (merge iff the first six card fields substantially coincide and only known-uses differ; keep separate iff obligation OR guarantee differs even under identical impl tech) reduces them to a smaller set of canonical pattern families, the remainder retained as variants / components / known-uses that preserve the case's technical texture. The false-merger guard is load-bearing: patterns are named after the RELATION modeled/enforced, never the implementation technology (all lints are not one pattern; all models are not one executable model).

_method.merge_rule: MERGE two cards iff first SIX fields (failure_class / engineering_obligation / solution_structure / guarantee / semantic_level / forces_tradeoffs) are substantially the same AND only known_uses differ. KEEP SEPARATE iff engineering_obligation OR guarantee differs, even when impl tech is identical.
_method.false_merger_guard: Preserve the RELATION modeled/enforced, not the impl mechanism. Distinct relations stay distinct patterns even when both are 'a lint' or both are 'a model'.
_method.name_after_abstraction: Each card's impl-biased title was renamed to its pattern-level abstract name before component-vs-variant sorting; used card.abstract_name where present, refined otherwise.
_method.rubric: 10 dims 0/1/2: Novelty · Agentic-significance · Durability · Generality · Principle-relevance · Architectural-depth · Evidence · Tradeoffs · Compositional-value · Wow-factor. 16-20 almost-certainly-print · 12-15 print-if-breadth/story · 8-11 sidebar/online · <8 local-doc. Overrides: Foundational / Awesome / Coverage / Case / Historical.
_method.levels: L1 Principle (explanatory claim, not an entry) · L2 Canonical mechanism (reusable structure providing a capability) · Composition (mechanisms strong together) · L3 Variant/component/known-use (folds under an L2).

L1_principles.name: Bind intent to structured models
L1_principles.claim: The environment's authoritative knowledge lives in typed models the fleet reasons through, not in prose or scattered code — intent and structure are represented so a bounded-context agent can operate a context-exceeding system.

L1_principles.name: Reconcile models with reality
L1_principles.claim: A model is only trustworthy while it equals the territory; every authoritative representation owes a mechanical check that it still matches the code/system it describes.

L1_principles.name: Constrain action through sanctioned surfaces
L1_principles.claim: Probabilistic actors are bounded by making the unsafe move structurally impossible — route mutation through one typed surface, express authority and repair as closed vocabularies, hold each with a ban-lint.

L1_principles.name: Re-derive evidence rather than trust reports
L1_principles.claim: Completion and correctness are established by recomputing evidence, never by trusting an actor's self-report — the gate re-runs the checks itself.

L1_principles.name: Convert recurring failures into enforced controls
L1_principles.claim: A failure that recurs is converted, once, into a deterministic control that fires on every subsequent change — audit findings become lints; the memory moves from the reviewer into the substrate.
expressed_by: the majority of catalogue entries qua controls

L1_principles.name: Preserve provenance and accountability
L1_principles.claim: Every inserted artifact and every consequential action carries a durable, machine-checkable trace back to its cause, so any change can be explained, audited, and reversed.

L1_principles.name: Model the governance environment itself
L1_principles.claim: Once controls proliferate, the control estate becomes a system in its own right and must itself be modeled, covered, and reasoned over — governance-of-governance.

L1_principles.name: Enforce at the right semantic level
L1_principles.claim: A control must fire at the level where the property actually lives (structural → deterministic check; semantic → model/judge) and be as legible as the failure it prevents — the placement judgment that explains WHERE every other mechanism sits.
expressed_by: agent/governance-doc-controls/semantic-level-enforcement (this entry IS the principle, lifted out of the pattern set)

Executable Source of Truth.intent: Maintain authoritative system knowledge as machine-readable typed data that is continuously consumed and mechanically held true — the interface through which a context-bounded agent operates a context-exceeding system.
Executable Source of Truth.relation: model ⟷ reality (the model is also the authoritative source that generates parts of the territory)
Executable Source of Truth.override: Foundational — the flagship of the Modeling thesis; the whole model zoo hangs off it.
Executable Source of Truth.vivid_failure: a stale architecture paragraph that no longer matched the code, so agents reasoned from a lie
Executable Source of Truth.concrete_impl: the typed system-models bridge (component/zone, service-flow, deployment, ...) projected data-not-code and held true by build-time gates
Executable Source of Truth.variants_note: The subject-specific declared models below are VARIANTS/known-uses: each shares the six-field structure (declare authoritative typed data + build-time parity) and differs only in WHICH RELATION it models and its known-uses. Per BEWARE FALSE MERGERS each variant preserves its distinct relation (recorded in its disposition) — they are folded, not collapsed.

Read the Model, Don't Copy It.abstract_name: Read the Model, Don't Copy It
Read the Model, Don't Copy It.intent: Consumers derive answers from the live model at use time — a copied-out value is banned, so one authoritative answer holds and a model change updates every consumer at once.
Read the Model, Don't Copy It.relation: consumer value → live model query (the copy relation banned)
Read the Model, Don't Copy It.override: Foundational — the consumption discipline that keeps a single source of truth actually single.
Read the Model, Don't Copy It.vivid_failure: a value snapshotted out of the model drifted from it, silently disabling a check keyed on the stale copy
Read the Model, Don't Copy It.concrete_impl: a ban-lint that flags copied-out model values on policed paths; consumers query the model at use time

Composed State-Machine Model.intent: Author the concurrency composition as one checkable object — which lifecycles exist, how they compose, and the predicates that must hold ACROSS them — each predicate carrying a derived verification obligation.
Composed State-Machine Model.relation: composed lifecycle legality + cross-machine predicates — what may happen over time, across machines (distinct from any single machine's transition graph)
Composed State-Machine Model.override: Awesome — composed lifecycle machines with cross-machine property checks (inclusion crit 12).
Composed State-Machine Model.vivid_failure: two async lifecycles legal alone deadlocked when composed; no single-machine model could see it
Composed State-Machine Model.concrete_impl: typed lifecycle machines + cross-machine invariants, the specification a formal verifier runs against
Composed State-Machine Model.composition: pairs with formal-invariant-verification (Model-Derived Assurance Coverage) — spec + checker

Drift / Parity Gate.intent: Keep the map equal to the territory bidirectionally — a build-blocking parity predicate fails the moment the model or the reality drifts unilaterally.
Drift / Parity Gate.relation: model ⟷ reality — bidirectional parity as a build-blocking invariant
Drift / Parity Gate.override: Foundational — the enforcement that makes Executable Source of Truth trustworthy (a model without a parity gate degrades to a snapshot).
Drift / Parity Gate.vivid_failure: a moved directory silently staled every tool's private inference of the tree
Drift / Parity Gate.concrete_impl: bidirectional parity lints wired into the build; divergence in either direction fails it
Drift / Parity Gate.variants_note: coherence-lints (cross-source relational parity), doc-hygiene-lints (corpus↔index parity), ddt-pin-trailers (test↔cited-source freshness) are known-use variants — same model⟷reality relation applied across different source pairs; each preserved distinctly.

Model-Derived Assurance Coverage.intent: Derive the assurance obligation from the model itself — the should-be-tested denominator, the test tier, the assertion strength, the verification method — and lint the gap, so an untested obligation is a named finding whose set regrows with every model change.
Model-Derived Assurance Coverage.relation: model-declared surface → owed assurance (obligation / placement / strength / method), denominator drawn from the model not the code
Model-Derived Assurance Coverage.override: Awesome — test evidence ↔ modeled invariants; coverage measured over meanings, not lines.
Model-Derived Assurance Coverage.vivid_failure: a green coverage percentage hid an entire untested category of model obligations
Model-Derived Assurance Coverage.concrete_impl: the obligation census derives owed tests from the models and lints the gap; four distinct-obligation variants fold under it
Model-Derived Assurance Coverage.variants_note: Five DISTINCT obligations kept as variants (not merged): obligation-census (completeness denominator), journey-criticality-test-placement (tier), journey-task-closure (assertion strength), coverage-model-mapping (per-node exercise), formal-invariant-verification (verification METHOD by temporal shape — the model-checking pole, composes with Composed State-Machine Model).

Governance Graph.intent: Model the control system itself — governance mechanisms as typed conflict edges over a closed shared-resource vocabulary — so a proposed control's collisions are checkable at authoring, not at the tripwire.
Governance Graph.relation: control × control → conflict over a shared resource (the interaction dual of the control census; join key is the typed resource, not the call)
Governance Graph.override: Coverage — the governance-of-governance class (once controls proliferate the control estate needs modeling); Awesome facet: detecting control collisions.
Governance Graph.vivid_failure: two controls claimed the same slot with no ordering, colliding only when both fired in production
Governance Graph.concrete_impl: a typed interaction model; mechanically-decidable conflict classes (same-slot no-order, lock cycles) caught by construction
Governance Graph.variants_note: control-coverage-census is the COVERAGE lens of the same governance-of-governance subject (control → governance target, portfolio completeness over a closed target taxonomy) — a distinct relation, folded here as the census variant.

Computed Control Blast Radius.intent: Every control declares the substrate assumption it bakes in as a typed fact, so 'what breaks when I change this substrate' is a computed query before the change, not archaeology after it.
Computed Control Blast Radius.relation: control → substrate assumption (the governance fleet's own dependency edges made typed and queryable)
Computed Control Blast Radius.override: Awesome — the blast radius of an architectural migration across governance controls, computed not grepped.
Computed Control Blast Radius.vivid_failure: a substrate migration silently broke controls whose dependency on it lived only in someone's memory
Computed Control Blast Radius.concrete_impl: each control declares its typed substrate stance; blast radius is a query over the declarations

Re-Derived Definition of Done.intent: Establish completion by independently re-derived evidence against the current state — never by recorded assertion; trust nothing written down before now.
Re-Derived Definition of Done.relation: completion claim ⊨ re-derived evidence at current state — completion moves from assertion to recomputation
Re-Derived Definition of Done.override: Foundational — the Alignment-thesis completion flagship (replace self-report with recomputed evidence).
Re-Derived Definition of Done.vivid_failure: an effort self-marked done while its owned checks had rotted and its commits never actually landed
Re-Derived Definition of Done.concrete_impl: the close tool re-runs every owned check + verifies commit ancestry against the substrate as it stands now
Re-Derived Definition of Done.composition: pairs with the evidence-bound commit gate (tree-sha markers) — cheap replay-proof evidence at commit, full re-derivation at close

One Door Enforced.abstract_name: One Door Enforced (sole sanctioned mutation surface)
One Door Enforced.intent: Route all mutation of a hazardous resource through one typed surface that encodes its invariants, with the raw alternative structurally banned — the bug made unrepresentable, not reviewed for. (Our instance: PdfModel, held by a raw-iText ban-lint.)
One Door Enforced.relation: every mutation → the sanctioned typed seam (construction, held by a counted detection sensor)
One Door Enforced.vivid_failure: a raw library call bypassed the format's invariants and shipped a corrupt tag tree (the v172 corruption)
One Door Enforced.concrete_impl: PdfModel is the sole PDF mutation surface; a ban-lint keeps every call site off raw iText
One Door Enforced.variants_note: Same one-door RELATION over different resources, folded as known-uses (distinct resource, distinct guarantee-boundary preserved): office-models (defect-class consolidation on a 2nd object model), raw-redis-seam (shared-state + schema seam), service-client (typed cross-service seam — the signature is the enforcement), canonical-walkers (the traversal component: one walker per tree).

Closed Action Vocabulary.intent: Make the actor's move-space a closed, named, typed set — bounding the action space is what makes attribution, validation, and policy tractable at all; an absent action forces a deliberate vocabulary addition.
Closed Action Vocabulary.relation: every mutation ∈ the closed verb vocabulary (the bounded action space over the artifact)
Closed Action Vocabulary.override: Foundational — bounding a probabilistic actor's move-space is what makes every downstream governance question finite.
Closed Action Vocabulary.vivid_failure: an open-ended repair space made attribution and validation questions unanswerable — anything could have happened
Closed Action Vocabulary.concrete_impl: a closed, typed remediation-verb set; every mutation is one named verb
Closed Action Vocabulary.variants_note: typed-categories (closed typed enum with exhaustiveness as the checkable property — category variant), role-typed-dispatch (the same closed-vocabulary move applied to AUTHORITY: bundles of capability as a typed role, enforced at every gated op), codemod-first (an execution-MODE vocabulary — soft threshold rule bounding how bulk change executes).

Machine-Enforced Semantic Policy.intent: Encode every mechanically-detectable domain invariant as a blocking check with scoped, reason-bearing escapes — audits become lints; policy moves from reviewer memory into durable machinery. (The distinctively agentic force: agents produce violations too fast for human review.)
Machine-Enforced Semantic Policy.relation: implementation ⊨ semantic policy — per-source domain invariants over the tool's own code (a DISTINCT relation from parity, provenance-coverage, and seam-mediation, even though all use lint technology)
Machine-Enforced Semantic Policy.override: Foundational — the operational form of P5 (convert recurring failures into enforced controls).
Machine-Enforced Semantic Policy.vivid_failure: a policy that lived in reviewer memory was silently violated once the reviewer was a fleet; worse, a checker became the hazard (a ReDoS regex — the fix was deleting the regex surface, not linting the bug)
Machine-Enforced Semantic Policy.concrete_impl: the blocking-semantic-lint fleet with scoped reason-bearing suppressions
Machine-Enforced Semantic Policy.false_merger_note: NOT merged with Drift/Parity Gate, Caused-By Provenance's wiring lint, or the mediator ban-lints — all are 'lints' but enforce different relations.

Preservation Invariant.intent: Make semantic preservation a deterministic post-condition checked on every produced artifact — the input's content must survive as a subset of the output — with a per-stage variant that names the stage that lost it.
Preservation Invariant.relation: input content ⊆ output content — the preservation invariant over the artifact
Preservation Invariant.override: Coverage/Case — the semantic-preservation class; indispensable to DocAble's correctness posture.
Preservation Invariant.vivid_failure: a remediation pass silently dropped document content — 'ran successfully but produced garbage'
Preservation Invariant.concrete_impl: ContentValidator checks input ⊆ output on every artifact; a staging variant localizes the offending pass
Preservation Invariant.composition: the payoff of the sanctioned seam + provenance stack — damage through the one door is caught here

Conformance-to-External-Spec Engine.intent: Make conformance a deterministic predicate in which every finding names the external-standard clause it closes, and keep the coverage claim honest (covered / gap / aspirational) by a same-commit discipline.
Conformance-to-External-Spec Engine.relation: finding → external-standard clause — the artifact ⊨ an external conformance specification, clause-grounded
Conformance-to-External-Spec Engine.override: Case/Coverage — indispensable to understanding DocAble (the product IS a conformance tool) + represents the external-spec-conformance class.
Conformance-to-External-Spec Engine.vivid_failure: an opaque conformance score could not be defended clause by clause when a claim was challenged
Conformance-to-External-Spec Engine.concrete_impl: the WCAG/standards rule engine; each finding cites its clause, coverage tracked covered/gap/aspirational

Caused-By Provenance.intent: Attach durable attribution at the point of every mutation and check that the wiring is COMPLETE over a closed verb set, so the artifact's mutation history — who changed what, and why — is reconstructable on demand. (Our instance: per-mutator stamps + a wiring lint + a derived changelog.)
Caused-By Provenance.relation: every mutation site → embedded provenance; every mutation verb → wired emission (coverage-completeness); every change → its typed cause
Caused-By Provenance.override: Foundational + Awesome — reconstruct a document's mutation history from embedded provenance; the strong composition (seam → stamps → wiring-lint → changelog) is the showcase.
Caused-By Provenance.vivid_failure: an input-vs-output diff could say WHAT changed but never WHO or WHY, so a remediation could not be explained or reversed
Caused-By Provenance.concrete_impl: per-mutator stamps embedded at the mutation site, one sanctioned writer per format
Caused-By Provenance.components_note: A COMPOSED STACK, presented as one canonical pattern with named components (not merged-identical): a11y_-prefix (MARK the insertion + auto-register for validation), mutator-stamps (EMIT at the site), f10-wiring-lint (COVER: every verb wired, completeness legible + cheap), derive-changelog (READ: reconstruct the attributed history), caused-by-provenance (the AGENT-SIDE arm: every commit → typed cause from a closed taxonomy).

Generative Validation.intent: Falsify a specification with machine-generated inputs at two poles — invariant-shaped properties over tame inputs (round-trip, idempotence, laws) and wild adversarial inputs fixed to the stable spec point — with the structured model as the declared oracle in the deepest form.
Generative Validation.relation: generated input → declared specification (invariant / stable spec point); the model-as-oracle collapses the rich-oracle-vs-wild-input tradeoff
Generative Validation.override: Awesome (facet) — the model-as-oracle synthesis is the distinctive contribution; property/fuzz alone are standard practice (exclusion crit 2/9).
Generative Validation.vivid_failure: a fix aimed at a failing fuzz SEED passed that seed and still broke every other spec-allowed input
Generative Validation.concrete_impl: fuzz campaigns with RCA to the stable spec point + coverage measurement; FsCheck property tests at the tame-input pole
Generative Validation.merge_rationale: The two entries self-frame as 'two sides of one coin' — same obligation (falsify the spec over generated inputs), same guarantee shape (confidence by sampling, not proof), differing only in the oracle/input pole. Merged; property-tests is the tame-oracle pole, fuzz the wild-input pole.

Derived Traceability.intent: Make every cross-layer join a typed, DERIVED edge re-proven against live reality at read time — derived edges defend, snapshotted ones drift; liveness is a property of the representation (resolution IS the read), not a sync process running beside a stored graph.
Derived Traceability.relation: model element ⟷ its enforcing/verifying/governed artifacts — the join web between abstraction levels, held by derivation rather than storage
Derived Traceability.override: Awesome — unusually strong evidence discipline (designed from observed drift, validated on an independent drift set); the rung above a parity gate (derive the edge so it cannot drift).
Derived Traceability.vivid_failure: a stored traceability edge went stale silently — the map claimed a join that reality had severed
Derived Traceability.concrete_impl: symbol-anchored edges re-provable against live reality; a broken join reddens at scan time, a resolving anchor means the claim is currently true
Derived Traceability.composition: the highest rung over Drift/Parity Gate — where parity CHECKS a stored model against reality, Derived Traceability removes the store so drift is unrepresentable

Validated Dispatch.intent: Structurally validate the instruction packet that confers autonomy BEFORE granting it — a work order that launches an autonomous actor is deterministically checked at the point of no return, not by probabilistic review. (Pre-authorization of autonomous work.)
Validated Dispatch.relation: dispatch artifact ⊨ launch contract — the brief's declared marker/snippet set conforms to the schema of what makes a launch safe; governs the work order, not the work
Validated Dispatch.override: Foundational — distinctively agentic: admission on the WORK ORDER itself, pre-authorizing autonomy.
Validated Dispatch.vivid_failure: a brief missing its worktree-isolation marker launched an agent that edited main directly — the failure surfaced downstream, not at authoring
Validated Dispatch.concrete_impl: a deterministic pre-dispatch lint over the brief (marker battery + genre-gated checks) wired into the sole launch path; exit 1 refuses the launch
Validated Dispatch.components_note: mandatory-snippet-table (the enumerable registry the lint reads — the check SOURCE), epic-and-design-templates (the same schema-on-the-artifact move applied to PLANNING artifacts — a kin variant, distinct obligation: analytic-section completeness vs launch safety).

Staged Admission Gates.intent: Order verification cheap-to-expensive along the path to production, each rung independently re-checkable, so no user is exposed to an unverified build and a predictably doomed run is never started.
Staged Admission Gates.relation: release candidate ⊨ ordered admission contract — verification precedes exposure, staged by cost; each rung's pass is a checkable fact, not a trusted one
Staged Admission Gates.override: Foundational (for the staircase) — standard practice lifted by agentic deploy velocity; two rungs carry distinctive sub-ideas (evidence-bound tree-sha commit gate; independence-proved-before-integration).
Staged Admission Gates.vivid_failure: an unverified build reached users because the expensive check ran only after promotion
Staged Admission Gates.concrete_impl: canary → smoke → promote on traffic-free surfaces; a doomed deploy refused before it starts
Staged Admission Gates.variants_note: The staircase's rungs, each a known-use: pre-commit-hook (evidence-bound commit gate — tree-sha markers make 'checks ran green on THIS tree' replay-proof; the strong sub-idea), sentinel-first-commit (t≈0 fail-fast substrate assertion), merge-train-mis-batching (integration rung — conflict-freedom proved BY CONSTRUCTION before landing; MIS is one implementation of 'independence before integration', the durable idea), cron-alerts-gate (health-conditioned admission — promote an observability signal into a blocking barrier), test-onion-tiers (the cost stratification the rungs consume).

Authoritative Lifecycle State.intent: Make destructive lifecycle decisions consult an authoritative recorded fact of liveness and disposition — never an inference from side effects; the record precedes the reclaim.
Authoritative Lifecycle State.relation: destructive operation ⊨ recorded lifecycle state — authority over 'what is alive / accounted for' moves from inferred filesystem signals to an authoritative append-only record
Authoritative Lifecycle State.override: Foundational — the record-before-destructive-action principle, carried by a vivid scar.
Authoritative Lifecycle State.vivid_failure: a cleanup heuristic inferred an agent was dead from filesystem signals and destroyed a LIVE worktree mid-run
Authoritative Lifecycle State.concrete_impl: an append-only agent-registry consulted before any reclaim; tools refuse to operate on an agent whose live marker exists
Authoritative Lifecycle State.variants_note: tombstone-commits is the CLOSE-RECORD variant: an irreversible reclaim justified by a durable, machine-checkable close record carrying an explicit disposition — cleanup proves safety from the record instead of guessing intent off a branch. Same obligation, at the close moment.

Mediated Resource Admission.intent: Mediate shared-resource use through a single admission point at a chosen cardinality (destructive ⇒ exclusive N=1; parallel-safe-heavy ⇒ bounded M), with the raw unmediated path structurally impossible rather than conventionally discouraged, and the permitted seams declared in a model so a coverage lint detects every bypass.
Mediated Resource Admission.relation: every invocation → the authorized mediated seam at a bounded cardinality (mediation on the COUNT of admitted work)
Mediated Resource Admission.override: Foundational — the directive's own exemplar of a good pattern (inclusion crit 1: mediator + single-writer contract declared in a model + coverage lint > 'use a wrapper'). Variants are local infra (exclusion crit 4).
Mediated Resource Admission.vivid_failure: concurrent agents ran the destructive test runner simultaneously and corrupted each other's shared build state
Mediated Resource Admission.concrete_impl: an N=1 host flock on the test runner, the raw path banned; coverage checked against the declared concurrency-contracts model
Mediated Resource Admission.variants_note: Cardinality variants of ONE relation: build-serializer (bounded M=8 for parallel-safe-heavy compute), aggregate-compute-protection (whole-sweep singleton — mediation at the granularity of the aggregate job). Its MODEL side is concurrency-contracts (declared coverage over the mediation regime).

Adaptive Resource-Pressure Admission.intent: Admit AND continue heavy work only under bearable live conditions — one shared pressure signal consulted both when work is admitted and while it runs, so a RED host neither starts new heavy work nor is left running it (admit-before, shed-during).
Adaptive Resource-Pressure Admission.relation: work admission/continuation ⊨ live resource condition — gating on the STATE of the environment (vs the cardinality mediators' gating on the COUNT)
Adaptive Resource-Pressure Admission.override: Coverage — represents the ADAPTIVE pole the directive mandates splitting out of the mediator family (split by forces + guarantees, not 'both control compute').
Adaptive Resource-Pressure Admission.vivid_failure: fixed concurrency slots still let heavy work pile onto a host already thrashing, because the count was fine but the machine was not
Adaptive Resource-Pressure Admission.concrete_impl: one shared pressure signal read at admit + during execution; shed on RED (as-built: the load-pressure ADMISSION gate is a flagged extension; shed + disk-floor wired)
Adaptive Resource-Pressure Admission.split_rationale: SPLIT from Mediated Resource Admission per the directive: the obligation (gate on live condition + shed-during) and guarantee (bearable conditions, not a fixed count) differ, even though both 'control compute'.

Fleet Observability Surface.intent: Make operational health a queryable, self-documenting, typo-proof signal surface and bind every signal to a prescribed response — emission alone is not observability; the loop is emit → interpret → react.
Fleet Observability Surface.relation: substrate event → typed topic → prescribed response — each signal carries its own interpretation and reaction (vs free-form logs that carry neither)
Fleet Observability Surface.override: Coverage — the observability class; the agentic delta is typed topics + a bound response (the reactor loop), not raw logging.
Fleet Observability Surface.vivid_failure: operational failures scrolled past in free-form logs that carried neither their meaning nor a prescribed response
Fleet Observability Surface.concrete_impl: an orchestrator-as-reactor over a typed event bus; topics enumerable, each bound to a playbook response
Fleet Observability Surface.variants_note: deploy-heartbeats is the progress-liveness variant: a long operation emits periodic progress so 'no heartbeat for N windows' reads deterministically as stale (liveness ≠ correctness). cron-alerts-gate is the promote-signal-into-a-gate composition (see Staged Admission Gates).

Point-of-Action Policy Delivery.intent: Deliver the constraint that governs an action to the actor at the point and moment of action — a runtime lifecycle event fires the check deterministically, converting policy from available (pull, optional) to binding (pushed into the mandatory task spec).
Point-of-Action Policy Delivery.relation: runtime lifecycle event / change-target → guaranteed delivery of the governing constraint at the decision point ('hard delivery of soft guidance')
Point-of-Action Policy Delivery.override: Historical/Case (partial) — the durable core is interposition (guaranteed firing at a runtime moment); two variants compensate for current-runtime limits (exclusion crit 3) and belong more online than in print.
Point-of-Action Policy Delivery.vivid_failure: a step owed at a runtime moment depended on the actor remembering it, and was silently skipped
Point-of-Action Policy Delivery.concrete_impl: lifecycle hooks (turn-stop / compaction / session-start / pre-action) split into guaranteed firing + a payload that blocks (hard) or aims (soft)
Point-of-Action Policy Delivery.variants_note: dynamic-context-injection is the flagship FEED-FORWARD variant (slice the meta-substrate to just the rules governing THESE files, push them into the task spec — durable idea: 'every meta-substrate becomes a JIT constraint registry once you add a slicing operator'; but its context-reinjection face is model-progress-vulnerable). reflection-facet-substrate is the FEED-BACK variant (soft nudges under one shared attention budget — transient).

Governed Knowledge Base.intent: Govern the document that carries the governance: the boot-context map of the rules must itself be bounded, canonical (one home per rule), admission-gated, and mechanically enforced — the delivery vehicle for every converted failure is itself under mechanism.
Governed Knowledge Base.relation: governance corpus → bounded binding index (rule → exactly-one canonical home; fleet-context ⊇ index) — the record of the mechanisms is itself under mechanism
Governed Knowledge Base.override: Foundational — the rule index IS the fleet's shared boot context; without governing it, the whole failure→mechanism move rots at its root.
Governed Knowledge Base.vivid_failure: the governance index grew unbounded and citations rotted, so agents booted from a map that no longer matched the rules
Governed Knowledge Base.concrete_impl: a size-capped, admission-gated rule index with stable citable numbering + cross-reference integrity lints
Governed Knowledge Base.merge_rationale: claude-md-rule-index and docs-hierarchy are deliberately two LENSES on ONE artifact (the bounded canonical rule index — the enforcement lens + the boot-context lens); merged per 3a.

Encoded Operational Judgment.intent: Pre-reason each recurring operational situation once, when nothing is burning — encode trigger, ordered steps, and reflexes-to-avoid — lead with the positive model of how the substrate works healthy, generate the runbook from a typed source of truth, and keep it honest by reference validation.
Encoded Operational Judgment.relation: operational situation → prescribed response, over a substrate ⟷ positive-operational-model relation; encoded judgment keyed by the situation, not by the doc
Encoded Operational Judgment.override: Coverage — the operations-knowledge class; the agentic delta over ordinary runbooks is generated-from-model + ref-lint-kept + positive-model-first.
Encoded Operational Judgment.vivid_failure: an operator improvised a recovery under fire and took a reflex the situation specifically punishes, because the judgment lived in no one's reach at the moment of need
Encoded Operational Judgment.concrete_impl: situation-keyed playbooks; an operator runbook skill generated from the lifecycle model, every pointer ref-checked against disk
Encoded Operational Judgment.variants_note: operator-runbook-skill is the GENERATED + symptom-indexed + positive-model-first variant (leads with how the substrate works healthy, falls back to symptom routing; kept honest by a ref-check since a non-executable index earns trust from ref-validation, not tests). Its source model is lifecycle-model (under Executable Source of Truth).

compositions.name: The model-coherence stack
joins: Read the Model, Don't Copy It
compositions.why: A model is authoritative only when it is consumed live (read-don't-copy) AND held equal to reality (parity gate); the three together turn data-not-code into a source of truth that cannot silently drift. Derived Traceability is the highest rung — derive the join so parity is unnecessary.

compositions.name: The provenance + fidelity stack
compositions.why: Routing every mutation through one door makes complete provenance FEASIBLE (a wiring lint can cover a closed verb set); stamps feed a derived changelog; and the preservation invariant catches damage done THROUGH the sanctioned seam. The directive's canonical strong composition (seam → stamps → wiring-lint → changelog → validator).

compositions.name: The specification + verification stack
compositions.why: The composed state-machine model is the SPECIFICATION; formal invariant verification (a variant of Model-Derived Assurance Coverage) is the CHECKER routed by the invariant's temporal shape — spec + prover, proven across bounded interleavings or a counterexample.

compositions.name: The safe-launch stack
compositions.why: The dispatch lint (reading the mandatory-snippet registry) validates the work order; role-typed authority (a closed vocabulary over capability bundles) fixes what the launched actor may do. Pre-authorization of autonomy = well-formed order + bounded authority.

compositions.name: The evidence staircase
compositions.why: The pre-commit evidence gate binds cheap checks to an exact tree (replay-proof) so a later stage can CHECK not TRUST; the re-derived Definition of Done recomputes the full evidence at close. Cheap evidence early, full re-derivation late — never a trusted self-report.

compositions.name: The observe → react loop
compositions.why: A typed event bus emits + interprets; a playbook binds each signal to a prescribed response; the cron-alerts gate (a Staged-Admission variant) promotes a critical signal into a blocking barrier. Emission alone is not observability — the loop is emit → interpret → react → gate.

compositions.name: The resource-mediation pair
compositions.why: Fixed-capacity mediation bounds the COUNT of admitted heavy work (declared in the concurrency-contracts model, coverage-linted); adaptive pressure gating bounds by the live CONDITION of the host and sheds during. Split by forces + guarantees, they compose to bound compute on both axes.

compositions.name: The governance-of-governance stack
compositions.why: Once controls proliferate they become a system: the governance graph models their conflicts, the blast-radius model computes what a substrate change breaks across them, and the governed knowledge base keeps the bounded rule index that carries every control honest. P7 realized.

agent/context-and-dispatch/docs-hierarch.reason: The boot-context lens of the SAME artifact (one bounded canonical rule map shared by every actor). Merged with claude-md-rule-index per 3a — two views, one mechanism.

agent/context-and-dispatch/dynamic-conte.reason: Feed-forward variant (flagship): slice the meta-substrate to just the rules governing the change-target and push them into the mandatory task spec. Durable idea (JIT constraint registry via a slicing operator); its context-reinjection face is model-progress-vulnerable (exclusion crit 3).

agent/context-and-dispatch/role-typed-di.reason: The closed-vocabulary move applied to AUTHORITY: correlated authority+capability decisions bound into one declared role type, fixed at dispatch and enforced at every gated op (actor → authority profile). A closed vocabulary over bundles of authority; composes with Validated Dispatch (the policy side of the launch gate).

agent/gates-and-merge-train/merge-train-.reason: The integration rung: conflict-freedom established BY CONSTRUCTION before landing (no two members touch the same file). The directive's own exemplar of 'clever but distracts' — the durable idea is 'independence proved before integration'; MIS is one implementation, folded as a variant not a peer.

agent/gates-and-merge-train/pre-commit-h.reason: The first, cheapest rung: an evidence-bound commit gate whose tree-sha markers make 'checks ran green on THIS tree' a replay-proof fact a later stage can CHECK not TRUST. Strong sub-idea; composes with Re-Derived Definition of Done.

agent/gates-and-merge-train/sentinel-fir.reason: The t≈0 rung: assert environmental health at the earliest observable moment on the real dispatch path, so a doomed run aborts at minute one instead of minute sixty (bound the waste of unlandable work).

agent/governance-doc-controls/claude-md-.reason: Canonical (the enforcement lens of the bounded rule index).

agent/governance-doc-controls/doc-hygien.reason: Corpus-structure parity: doc corpus ⟷ its declared structure (index ⊇ docs; emitted file → declared emitter; pointer → resolvable target). Same parity relation applied to the documentation corpus; enforces the Governed Knowledge Base.

agent/governance-doc-controls/epic-and-d.reason: The same schema-on-the-artifact move applied to PLANNING artifacts (planning artifact ⊨ required-section schema). Kin variant, distinct obligation (analytic-section completeness vs launch safety); note the hollow-section limit — presence, not the thought in it.

agent/governance-doc-controls/mandatory-.reason: The enumerable registry of universal safety boilerplate that the dispatch lint reads — the check SOURCE (a checklist with no reader catches nothing). Component of Validated Dispatch.

agent/governance-doc-controls/operator-r.reason: Generated + symptom-indexed + positive-model-first variant, kept honest by reference validation. Same encode-operational-judgment relation, richer construction.

agent/governance-doc-controls/semantic-l.disposition: lift-to-L1 P8 (Enforce at the right semantic level)
agent/governance-doc-controls/semantic-l.reason: Not a peer pattern: a design-time PLACEMENT judgment (match a control's enforcement scope to the property's legibility scope) that EXPLAINS where every other mechanism sits. Lifted out of the pattern set to L1 per 3a.

agent/governance-doc-controls/self-gover.reason: New pattern (24th) added W3: the generative engine that turns a recurring failure class into a tasteful, proportionate control and fires that conversion on a cadence. Named after the portable relation (self-detection → right-sized constraint/sensor); the loadable INTERPRET-FAILURE skill + turn-end reflection hook are its operationalization, not the pattern. Flagship: the gov-of-gov stack's INTERPRET part (stack expanded to 6, RADIUS kept).

agent/lifecycle-and-observability/caused.reason: AGENT-SIDE arm: every repository change carries a typed cause from a closed taxonomy, minted at the cause and asserted at admission — a continuously-emitted traceability matrix, one row per commit. Same provenance capability, agent-side subject.

agent/lifecycle-and-observability/cron-a.reason: Health-conditioned admission: a surfaced critical alert becomes a blocking barrier on admitting NEW work (availability → binding, applied to alerts). The promote-a-sensor-into-a-gate move; composes with Fleet Observability Surface.

agent/lifecycle-and-observability/deploy.reason: Progress-liveness variant: periodic progress evidence so staleness is decidable from signal absence (liveness ≠ correctness). Distinct signal, same observability surface.

agent/lifecycle-and-observability/lifecy.reason: Canonical interposition mechanism (guaranteed firing at a runtime moment).

agent/lifecycle-and-observability/reflec.reason: Feed-back variant: soft policy nudges aggregated under one shared attention budget (cap the family's aggregate emission, not each member). Historically-contingent (transient runtime-limit compensation).

agent/lifecycle-and-observability/tombst.reason: Close-record variant: an irreversible reclaim justified by a durable close record with an explicit disposition — cleanup proves safety from the record instead of guessing intent off a branch.

agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/aggre.reason: Whole-sweep singleton variant: mediation at the granularity of the aggregate job (one whole-sweep in flight per host). Same mediation relation, coarser unit.

agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/build.reason: Bounded-M cardinality variant: parallel-safe-heavy compute rationed at M=8; cardinality chosen from the contention profile. Same mediation relation, different cardinality.

agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/resou.reason: Adaptive-condition SHED variant, folded into the mediation family per W3 ruling: it bounds heavy work by the host's live CONDITION (an admission gate before dispatch + an execution shed during), where the fixed mediators bound by declared COUNT. Same mediation relation, condition-vs-count axis. Stays the SHED member of the resource-mediation flagship stack.

agent/mediators-and-resource-locks/test-.reason: Canonical single-writer (N=1) mediation with structural ban.

models-bridge/system-models/agent-first-.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: CONSTRUCTION-METHOD variant — frozen typed records, adopt the best genre's schema, skip its runtime; hand-roll and own the executable layer per view

models-bridge/system-models/agent-orches.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: the same MBSE method pointed at the FLEET substrate (developer-journey + operator-loop legality) — the production substrate made as checkable as the product [SHOWPIECE: second subject arm]

models-bridge/system-models/component-zo.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: structural ownership relation (file → component/zone/boundary); the fix-once registry every tool queries, held by bidirectional parity

models-bridge/system-models/concurrency-.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: MODEL side of Mediated Resource Admission — 'who may run this, how many at once' declared as data so COVERAGE (not just seam-enforcement) is checkable; composes with the mediator pattern

models-bridge/system-models/control-cove.reason: The COVERAGE lens of governance-of-governance: control → governance target, portfolio completeness over a closed complementary-targets taxonomy, re-derived on every query. Distinct relation from control×control conflict; folded as the census variant of the same subject.

models-bridge/system-models/coverage-mod.reason: GRANULARITY obligation: per model node (state/seam/invariant) 'is this tested?' is a queried fact a threshold cannot hide. Distinct obligation (exercise over meanings).

models-bridge/system-models/data-flow-mo.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: governed-flow relation (data category → transitively-reachable sinks); compliance properties evaluated as graph walks — the transitive question no flat list answers

models-bridge/system-models/deployment-t.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: physical-topology relation (service → tier/layer/host) plus layering constraints, parity-checked against deploy tables + import graph

models-bridge/system-models/domain-regis.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: fact canonicalization (domain fact → single typed home); coverage/parity-linted, docs generated from it

models-bridge/system-models/formal-invar.reason: METHOD obligation: route each invariant to the checker its temporal shape (safety/liveness) demands — the model-checking pole (proof across bounded interleavings, or a counterexample). Strongest/showpiece variant; composes with Composed State-Machine Model.

models-bridge/system-models/invariant-da.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: the correctness-check DAG as a declared model with a TYPED POLICY LAYER (correctness graph host-invariant; concurrency/budget a profile over it); composes with Mediated Resource Admission

models-bridge/system-models/journey-crit.reason: PLACEMENT obligation: derive the test tier as a pure function of a criticality trait, with a floor guaranteeing local-green ⟹ every major path ran. Distinct obligation from the denominator census.

models-bridge/system-models/journey-task.reason: STRENGTH obligation: a major journey's terminal assertion provably has the shape of task closure, strength derived from the expression. Distinct obligation.

models-bridge/system-models/lifecycle-mo.reason: Subject model: operational subsystem → healthy-state predicate + symptom keying, prose as a projection of the model. A declared system model; its runbook projection is the composition with Encoded Operational Judgment.

models-bridge/system-models/meta-model-c.disposition: keep-as-L2 Read the Model, Don't Copy It

models-bridge/system-models/model-derive.reason: Canonical: derive the owed-test denominator, lint the gap.

models-bridge/system-models/model-driven.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: GENERATION face — artifact = f(model); real artifacts derived + provenance-marked so hand-edits and staleness fail the build

models-bridge/system-models/model-graded.disposition: demote-to-L3-under Read the Model, Don't Copy It
models-bridge/system-models/model-graded.reason: A model-CONSUMING gate: finding × change → severity via model distance, computed once against the live component model. Strong instance of reading-the-model to grade; no independent canonical status.

models-bridge/system-models/process-view.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: simultaneity/collision relation (process ∥ process over a shared resource, each race joined to its guard) — deliberately distinct from single-machine transition legality

models-bridge/system-models/query-surfac.disposition: demote-to-L3-under Read the Model, Don't Copy It
models-bridge/system-models/query-surfac.reason: The canonical self-describing READ API (one documented dialect) that makes 'read the model' ergonomic; soft, not a lint-banned monopoly.

models-bridge/system-models/required-con.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: completeness-as-admission (runtime env ⊇ role's declared required set); an incomplete environment refused at the door with the full gap [admission face; composes with Staged Admission]

models-bridge/system-models/rule-metadat.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: governance rule → enforcement + scope metadata; policy prose made a queryable model, claims cross-checked against real enforcers (governance-of-governance lean)

models-bridge/system-models/service-flow.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: structural who-exists-and-how-wired relation of the architecture (service topology + API contracts ⟷ deployed reality); wiring generated from the model

models-bridge/system-models/symbol-ancho.reason: Canonical CAP-SYNC derived-edge mechanism (3a-flagged standalone candidate).

models-bridge/system-models/synchronizat.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: synchronization-contract relation (lock → guarded resource + acquisition order); undeclared lock / inverted acquisition fail at author time

models-bridge/system-models/telemetry-co.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: observability-coverage relation (stream → origin/landing/per-env collection); distinguishes an absent stream from a true zero

models-bridge/system-models/timeout-budg.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: temporal containment ordering (inner budget < containing budget), proven for every declared pair — a latent prod hang converted to a build finding [SHOWPIECE known-use, Awesome]

models-bridge/system-models/typed-contra.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: boundary-shape relation (producer ⟷ declared contract ⟷ consumer) plus typed boundary policy (visibility/auth/stability); both sides reconcile at build time

models-bridge/system-models/user-journey.reason: Subject/face variant of Executable Source of Truth — same declare-typed-data+parity structure, distinct relation preserved: product goal → implementation surface (behavioral traversal joined down to endpoints); declared deps ⟷ real call sites, unlocks journey-aware differential scale-up

product/canonical-models-and-seams/canon.reason: Traversal COMPONENT: one walker per tree centralizes traversal invariants. Entry self-declares low novelty — a component of the sanctioned-surface pattern, not a peer.

product/canonical-models-and-seams/offic.reason: Defect-class-consolidation known-use: the same construction+ban pattern on a 2nd object model (per-format), so a fix benefits every format at once. The entries themselves frame it as consolidation.

product/canonical-models-and-seams/raw-r.reason: Shared-state-seam variant: the sole raw-Redis seam owns atomicity + the declared schema — 'no other place to write the bug'.

product/canonical-models-and-seams/servi.reason: Typed distributed variant: the ONE cross-service seam whose signature (bytes, not path) makes the type-confusion class unrepresentable.

product/provenance-and-attribution/a11y-.reason: MARK component: tool-inserted content made distinguishable by a checkable rule, every inserter auto-covered by validation via registration.

product/provenance-and-attribution/deriv.reason: READ component: provenance must have a consumer — reconstruct the attributed history from the artifact on demand (who + why, which a raw diff cannot answer).

product/provenance-and-attribution/f10-w.reason: COVER component: completeness of provenance over the closed verb set, pitched at 'was the call made on the way out' — the level where completeness is legible AND cheap. Distinct coverage relation (not parity, not semantic policy) though the tech is a lint.

product/provenance-and-attribution/mutat.reason: Canonical: emit durable attribution at the mutation site.

product/regression-tests/ddt-pin-trailer.reason: Test ⟷ cited-source freshness parity: editing a cited source obliges regenerating the pin's trailer in the same change. Parity applied to the tests-derived-from-docs join.

product/regression-tests/fuzz-campaigns.reason: Canonical (wild-input pole + model-as-oracle, the distinctive content).

product/regression-tests/property-tests.reason: The tame-oracle / rich-invariant pole of the same generative-validation pattern; the entries self-frame as two sides of one coin.

product/regression-tests/test-onion-tier.reason: Cost-stratified regression body: verification cost matched to the gated decision, with escalation rules. Standard practice (exclusion crit 2); the agentic delta is escalation + the 1-second discipline under fleet velocity. Sidebar/breadth — feeds the admission staircase.

product/repair-vocabulary/codemod-first.reason: Execution-mode variant: a soft threshold rule (N≳50 → one deterministic AST transform) bounding HOW bulk change executes. A process discipline, folded as the execution-mode face of a bounded action space.

product/repair-vocabulary/typed-categori.reason: Category variant: closed typed enum (ViolationCategory/FailureCategory) with exhaustiveness as the checkable property; external strings mapped in at a controlled boundary.

product/validation-and-conformance/coher.reason: Cross-source coherence: a declared relational invariant (subset/equality/one-to-one) between independent product sources — kin of model↔reality parity applied across sources. Distinct relation preserved.

product/validation-and-conformance/stand.reason: Departs the catalogue per W3 ruling C: it IS the product (an external-spec conformance engine), so it becomes a case section in the book proper (Part-5 product-case register), not a catalogue pattern. Its coherence/parity relatives (coherence-lints) stay under Drift/Parity Gate.
